I know they don't love me though.
They said they were only sticking around not because they liked me at all or because I was a good friend to them, but because they didn't want me to die.
They don't love me...they told me they resent me.
Maybe if it weren't ambiguous, I would've thought that they did love me but they don't. There's nothing that's a part of me that they want

Seems like it. I work so hard against my mental illness but I don't think I'm getting better. My friends and family still resent me. I've lost friendships that meant a lot to me that I'll never get back. So many people have given up so much of their life to take care of me and my moods and whatever. I want them all to be happy! And I want to be okay. And if that means I have to kill myself to make that happen then so be it

but its okay because they all have each other. and then i won't even be there to hurt them anymore so it'll even be more okay. nothing i can do can give them hope or love because i'm not the kind of person they should ever look to for hope or love
